preconditions.expression: n > 0 and m > 0 and isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(m, int) and n * m <= 200000
preconditions.description: The board dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are positive integers with total cells ≤ 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n rows in the input has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'U', 'D', 'L', 'R'} for row in stdin_lines[1:] for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell is marked with one of 'U', 'D', 'L', or 'R', representing a half-domino orientation.

preconditions.expression: all(any((i, j) == (i + di, j + dj) and stdin_lines[i + di][j + dj] == {'U': 'D', 'D': 'U', 'L': 'R', 'R': 'L'}[c] for di, dj in [(0, 1), (1, 0)] if 0 <= i + di < n and 0 <= j + dj < m) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) for c in [stdin_lines[i][j]])
preconditions.description: The tiling is valid: every half-domino has a matching counterpart in an adjacent cell (horizontally or vertically).

postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct pairs of free cells (photos) Bill can produce by removing one domino and moving others under the given constraints.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(pair, tuple) and len(pair) == 2 and 0 <= pair[0] < n and 0 <= pair[1] < m for pair in distinct_free_pairs)
postconditions.description: Each distinct free cell pair in the result is a valid coordinate pair (i, j) on the board.

postconditions.expression: all(pair1 != pair2 for pair1 in distinct_free_pairs for pair2 in distinct_free_pairs if pair1 != pair2)
postconditions.description: All pairs in the result are unique (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: all(any((i1, j1) == (i2, j2) or (i1, j1) == (i2 + di, j2 + dj) or (i2, j2) == (i1 + di, j1 + dj) for di, dj in [(0, 1), (1, 0)]) for (i1, j1) in distinct_free_pairs for (i2, j2) in distinct_free_pairs)
postconditions.description: Every pair of free cells in the result is either the same cell (invalid, but excluded by Q2) or adjacent horizontally or vertically (since dominoes cover adjacent cells).

postconditions.expression: all(any((i, j) == (i + di, j + dj) and (stdin_lines[i][j] == 'U' and stdin_lines[i + di][j + dj] == 'D') or (stdin_lines[i][j] == 'D' and stdin_lines[i + di][j + dj] == 'U') or (stdin_lines[i][j] == 'L' and stdin_lines[i + di][j + dj] == 'R') or (stdin_lines[i][j] == 'R' and stdin_lines[i + di][j + dj] == 'L') for di, dj in [(0, 1), (1, 0)]) for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The free cell pairs in the result are derived from valid domino removals and subsequent moves, where each domino's movement preserves adjacency to its original position.
